summary: FD_TC_193_VOL (Contact Center ADDCOL, No ACNP) ? INVOL (DT/COP) � Promise = Last VOL Before DT
title: VOL (Contact Center ADDCOL, No ACNP) ? INVOL (DT/COP) � Promise = Last VOL Before DT
description:
Customer voluntarily changed their flight via Contact Center (ADDCOL + no ACNP = VOL), then AC applied a DT (Day-of-Travel) schedule change (INVOL). Validates that the promise updates to the last VOL arrival (14:00) and that the subsequent DT does NOT further update the promise. Delay is calculated from the VOL-updated promise (14:00) to actual arrival (18:30).

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Nicolas Chartrand); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; Change 1 (D-7): CC VOL (ADDCOL, no ACNP) ? new arrival 14:00; Change 2 (D-0): DT (YTOAC0652 + I/S indicator) ? new arrival 18:30; Actual arrival: 18:30; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
